original_font_information.description: Space Grotesk is Florian Karsten's modification of Colophon Foundry's fixed-width Space Mono (2016). Originally designed for the Florian Karsten Typefaces website, Space Grotesk retains the monospace's idiosyncratic details while optimizing for improved readability at non-display sizes.
